text.tspan: Decadal average: Annual injury rate from all natural disasters

tspan.font-family: Lato, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif

text.tspan: Rates are measured per 100,000 people. Decadal figures are measured as the annual average over the subsequent ten-year
period. Disasters include events such as earthquakes, volcanoes, droughts, wildfires, storms, and floods.

tspan.tspan: EM-DAT, CRED / UCLouvain (2026); Population based on various sources (2024)
Based on recorded events; coverage is more limited before the year 2000. Longer historical trends may partly reflect reporting
